# Changelog
All notable changes to SwiftAI will be documented in this file.
The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.0.0/), and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).
## [Unreleased]
### Planned - Voice input and text-to-speech - Image generation with AI - Markdown rendering in messages - Message search and filtering - Export chat history (PDF, TXT) - Multi-language support (i18n) - Dark/Light theme toggle - Chat sharing functionality - Message reactions and emoji support - Push notifications for AI responses
---
## [1.0.0] - 2025-01-XX
### Added - ✨ Initial release of SwiftAI - AI chat functionality with Gemini AI integration - Beautiful Material 3 UI with dark theme - Firebase Authentication (Email/Password and Google Sign-In) - Firebase Firestore for cloud message storage - Room database for offline support - Real-time message synchronization - Multiple chat sessions support - ⚡ Typing indicators for AI responses - Clean Architecture (MVVM) implementation - Hilt dependency injection - Jetpack Compose Navigation - ️ AI Tools screen with specialized tools - Subscription system (Free, Standard, Pro, Max tiers) - ⚙️ Settings screen for user preferences - Home screen with chat history - Beautiful message bubbles (user vs AI) - Gradient backgrounds and smooth animations - Splash screen with branding
### Technical - Kotlin 1.9.20 - Jetpack Compose with Material 3 - Compose Compiler 1.5.4 - Target SDK 34 (Android 14) - Min SDK 24 (Android 7.0) - Firebase BOM 32.7.1 - Room 2.6.1 - Hilt 2.50 - OkHttp 4.12.0 - Coil 2.5.0 - Coroutines 1.7.3
---
## Version History
### [1.0.0] - Initial Release **Release Date**: 2025-01-XX
**Highlights**: - First stable release - Full AI chat functionality - Cloud sync with offline support - Beautiful Material 3 UI - Clean architecture implementation
**Features**: - AI chat with Gemini integration - Firebase authentication and storage - Real-time message synchronization - Multiple subscription tiers - AI tools and utilities - User profile management - Chat history persistence
**Known Issues**: - None reported
**Migration Notes**: - N/A (Initial release)
---
## Template for Future Releases
```markdown ## [X.Y.Z] - YYYY-MM-DD
### Added - New features
### Changed - Changes in existing functionality
### Deprecated - Soon-to-be removed features
### Removed - Removed features
### Fixed - Bug fixes
### Security - Security improvements ```
---
## Release Notes
### Version 1.0.0
SwiftAI is now available! This initial release brings AI-powered chat to Android with a beautiful, modern interface built entirely with Jetpack Compose.
**What's New**: - Chat with AI using multiple models - Real-time message sync across devices - Beautiful dark theme optimized for OLED - Offline support with local database - Secure authentication with Firebase - Multiple subscription tiers - Specialized AI tools
**Get Started**: 1. Download the app 2. Sign up or sign in 3. Start chatting with AI!
---
## Upgrade Guide
### Upgrading to 1.0.0 - First release, no upgrade needed
---
